scope: Queue/API bootstrap failure responders and environment-based error dispatch; separate from SDK inventory

source_validation.note: Includes the already-ported error-payload shape test; four additional source functions are mapped here

verified_contracts: Raw queue authorization, repeated $ID substitution, JSON-encoded error inside JSON with form content type
GET 90-second and POST 30-second request limits; 2-second non-200 and 5-second failure backoff
Empty polls, false IDs, malformed bodies, failed reports and recovery without worker initialization
Unauthenticated API error responses for GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH on all paths
Exact task/API routing and queue fallback for absent or unrecognized runtime kind
Task bootstrap error privacy, authenticated diagnostics, idle deletion acknowledgement and process exit
Shutdown during network polling, partial HTTP requests, and drop of embedded serving futures
native_adaptations: Owned clients and explicit shutdown futures replace globals and infinite blocking loops
Missing webhooks return a typed error; process callers choose the nonzero exit
Native JSON whitespace/escaping, HTTP framing and unsupported-method JSON replace Python formatting/HTML
Reqwest uses total request deadlines in place of urllib socket-operation timeouts
Non-Unicode environment values are treated as absent; native port parsing is limited to u16
pending_contracts: Live bootstrap orchestration and Python-compatible dependency verification (native deployed startup is tracked in runtime-bootstrap-startup.json)
Native deployment and automatic platform launch (packaging is tracked in native-artifact.json)
Live source resolution and executor integration
